title: Slovakian Vegan Fondue
description: A delicious and hearty Slovakian-inspired vegan fondue, perfect for a cold winter night. This recipe combines the rich flavors of Slovakia with the comfort of a warm, gooey fondue.
instructions: In a large pot, combine caraway seeds, garlic, and Slovakian mustard.
Heat the mixture over medium heat, stirring constantly, until fragrant.
Add the vegan cheese alternative and nutritional yeast. Stir until the cheese is melted and the mixture is smooth.
Transfer the fondue to a serving bowl and garnish with chopped parsley.
Serve immediately with sliced vegan bread.
Dip bread in the fondue and enjoy!
